summary: Frontend-only testing of new SacoparentsPortal (/) mobile-first single-page portal. All 15 requested features verified working end-to-end. LocalStorage persistence confirmed across reloads for court key, health index sliders, BIFF archive history, alignment records, foundation text, and legal report signatures. All data-testids present and stable. Font Awesome 6 CDN loads correctly (verified computed font-family). No backend calls made by this portal (as designed).
critical_code_review_comments: None blocking. Minor: DEFAULT_BIFF_LOGS is seeded on first mount so 'History of Communications' starts with 1 entry rather than empty — this matches the mockup demo intent, not a bug.

Note: preset-medical-update and preset-schedule-change both set risk to 'Escalation Flag' because their PRESETS.flags arrays are non-empty (Passive aggressive comment / Personal attack). This matches the mockup preset data — flagged for awareness, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Portal auto-seeds DEFAULT_ALIGNMENTS (3 records), DEFAULT_MILESTONES (2), DEFAULT_BIFF_LOGS (1), DEFAULT_FOUNDATION, DEFAULT_LEGAL_REPORT into localStorage on first load — idempotent (only seeds when key is null).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test viewport must be mobile (390x844). Portal is React SPA driven entirely by localStorage — no backend endpoints exist. Auto-accept window.alert/confirm/prompt via page.on('dialog',...). When toggling range sliders in Playwright, use the native HTMLInputElement value setter + dispatch 'input'/'change' events (React controlled inputs). Verified tests: gateway->door1, gateway->door2->demo-key-1->verify->banner (persisted), health-index sliders (persisted), hub tab switch, all 4 BIFF presets (raw+biff+flags+risk populated), custom-text real-time analysis (empty=Neutral, plain=Low Risk, 'always'/'!!'=Escalation Flag), archive->biff-history-list persists, add-alignment modal->folder count increments, folder-medical/educational/psychological filter + clear-folder-filter, log-reassessment modal saves to sacoparents_reassessments, foundation-text persists, sig-parent-a/b/mediator persists, nav-doors/nav-report/nav-biff/nav-print, header-back-btn returns to gateway, Font Awesome 6.4.0 renders correctly.
